parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese.

- en-US: English. This is the default value.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique token for each request. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance configuration. A GTM instance can have two configurations, an A record and an AAAA record, for the same access domain name. The ConfigId uniquely identifies one of the configurations. To obtain the ConfigId, call the [ListCloudGtmInstanceConfigs](~~2797349~~) operation.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0 instance.
